title: Camps family form: “Date signed” under the signature (v0.638, pass 2 L-08)
subtitle: The rule is already approved (v0.638, Jeffrey 2026-11-04, option B: every signature has its date signed). Star's and Black Belt's family forms already have the box (v0.522); this picture copies it for the camp family page (/camp/<code>) and for Fill in, which uses the same step. Real preview screens of the built page with the box tried (the preview set to Wed, Mar 10, 2027). Amber = what differs.

columns.label: Today

row.caption: PC: the signature ends the form. Nothing says when it was signed.

columns.note: Camps' staff screens never show the signature picture (Camper detail says “waiver signed on the form” with the sign-up day), so the staff part of v0.638 needs nothing here.

columns.label: After

row.caption: PC: a gray “Date signed” box under the signature hint, “Wed, Mar 10, 2027”, hint “Filled in automatically with today's date.”
Phone (390 and 320): the same box, 40 px tall like the form's other boxes.

items.caption: Fill in (the dashboard's dialog, same step): the same box, signed that day by the parent at the desk.

columns.note: The box is only shown: it can't be changed or sent. The database already saves the day the sign-up is sent (camp_signups.signed_at), so no database change.

footer: Words: “Date signed” and “Filled in automatically with today's date.” are the shared ones already in src/components/text.js (Star's v0.522). How it is built: copied from Star's family form (its own small box and CSS on the camp page), not a new shared component. Color Belt's own version is not on main yet, so there is no shared component to use.
